The role encompasses corporate legal advisory, contract management, regulatory compliance, risk management, and governance. Experience in the sports, venues, or entertainment sector is highly valued. Key Responsibilities Legal Advisory & Corporate Governance ● Serve as the primary legal advisor to the CEO, executive team, and Board of Directors on all legal and regulatory matters. ● Support the incorporation and establishment of the company as a legal entity, including all associated regulatory filings and government registrations. ● Advise on corporate governance frameworks, Board procedures, and joint venture obligations. ● Establish and maintain the Delegation of Authority (DOA) framework and monitor reserved matters. ● Manage the company's legal structure and ensure compliance with Saudi corporate law. Contracts & Commercial Legal Support ● Draft, review, negotiate, and manage all commercial contracts, including venue operation agreements, maintenance contracts, service-level agreements, event hosting agreements, licensing arrangements and supplier contracts. ● Develop and maintain contract templates and playbooks. ● Develop and maintain contract trackers and contract repository. ● Lead on all legal aspects of partnerships, joint ventures, and shareholder arrangements. ● Advise on legal considerations as relevant to the company’s operations including technology, intellectual property and data protection matters. ● Manage the legal aspects of Shared Services Agreements for the provision of back-office functional support (HR, Finance, Procurement, etc.). Risk Management & Dispute Resolution ● Identify and manage legal risks across all areas of the business. ● Lead the resolution of disputes, claims, and litigation matters and liaise with external legal counsel. ● Oversee insurance arrangements and risk mitigation strategies from a legal perspective. HR & Employment Law ● Advise on employment contracts, HR policies, labor law compliance, and disciplinary matters. ● Support the HR function on Saudization (Nitaqat) requirements and workforce planning from a legal perspective. GRC — Governance, Risk & Compliance ● Develop and implement the company's GRC framework, policies, and procedures. ● Lead anti-corruption, ethics, and compliance programs across the organization. ● Build governance capability across the organization. Leadership ● Develop the legal capability of the organization, leveraging external legal advisers. ● Establish scalable legal processes and governance to support organizational growth. ● Leverage AI and other technologies to generate efficiencies in the delivery of legal support.
